title: Linearity property of module cohomology maps
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an $\mathcal O_Y$-module and $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $\varphi:G\to h_*F$ a module morphism [def-pc-module-pullback], and $p\in\mathbb N$. Write $H^p$ for module cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology]. There exists an $\mathcal O_Y(Y)$-linear morphism from $H^p(Y,G)$ to $H^p(X,F)$, where the latter has scalars restricted along $h^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y(Y)\to\mathcal O_X(X)$, whose underlying additive morphism is $\varphi^*$ [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap].

theorem moduleCohomologyFMap_basic_linearity {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y)
    {G : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf} {F : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf}
    (φ : G ⟶ (pushforward h).obj F) (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ L : (Y.toRingedSpace.moduleCohomology p).obj G ⟶
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars h.appTop.hom).obj
            ((X.toRingedSpace.moduleCohomology p).obj F),
      (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).map L = moduleCohomologyFMap h φ p
